tool_args.rationale: The prior execution error was caused by an undefined training-data global, not by the hypothesis. This implementation fits the five avalanche-law parameters from the supplied paid rows and uses the fitted parameters for prediction; observations cover the threshold transition and match the requested forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three high-gradient measurements reveal a sharp sign-changing sink response.
Eight observations spanning both sides of the transition identify the threshold law sufficiently; an extra batch adds cost.
These smooth stationary alternatives do not account for the strongly negative outputs at high s_grad.
